name: Healthpeak Properties
description: Healthpeak is a healthcare REIT with interests in 689 properties at Dec 31, 2025: 507 outpatient medical buildings and hospitals, 145 lab (life-science) buildings and 34 senior housing communities. Outpatient medical and lab money is rent from health systems, physician groups, and biotech, pharma and device tenants. Senior housing is run under RIDEA structures, meaning Healthpeak books resident revenue and operating costs. In March 2026 it took the senior housing portfolio public as a separate REIT, Janus Living, in which it keeps a large stake and acts as external manager. It also completed the 2024 merger with Physicians Realty Trust (299 outpatient medical buildings acquired).

gics.note: Conventional GICS label as shown in Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (sector and sub-industry columns only; that list does not give industry group or industry). Read 2026-09-30.

businessLines.name: Outpatient medical
businessLines.how: Health systems and physician practices pay rent per square foot on multi-year leases, with the buildings usually next to hospital campuses; growth from rent escalators and renewals.
businessLines.description: Outpatient medical buildings and hospitals (486 consolidated properties, 34.6M sq ft; 507 including joint ventures).

businessLines.name: Lab
businessLines.how: Biotech, pharma and device companies pay rent per square foot, the highest rent in the portfolio, so income tracks life-science funding and demand for lab space.
businessLines.description: Life-science lab and office buildings in business-park campus settings (135 consolidated properties, 11.1M sq ft; 145 including joint ventures).

businessLines.name: Senior housing
businessLines.how: Residents pay monthly fees for housing and care; Healthpeak books the resident revenue and carries the operating costs (managers paid a fee), so profit swings with occupancy and wages.
businessLines.description: Life plan communities and a joint venture with a sovereign wealth fund (34 communities, 10,422 units in total) operated through RIDEA structures; contributed to Janus Living in March 2026.

businessLines.name: Other non-reportable (loans, preferred equity, 3 properties)
businessLines.how: Interest on loans and preferred equity plus rent on three small properties.
businessLines.description: Loans receivable, a preferred equity investment and three other properties.
